name: Hazezon, Shaper of Sand
oracle_text:
Desertwalk (This creature can't be blocked as long as defending player controls a Desert.)
You may play Desert lands from your graveyard.
Whenever a Desert you control enters, create two 1/1 red, green, and white Sand Warrior creature tokens.
blocked_sentences: You may play Desert lands from your graveyard.

needs.what: a filter on the `play_lands_from_graveyard` player-wide static -- "You may play Desert lands from your graveyard" -- so `legality._land_actions` offers only the graveyard lands matching it (here {"subtypes": ["Desert"]}), per object, rather than the whole graveyard
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `player_plays_lands_from_graveyard` answers a bare yes/no and `_land_actions` then appends the whole graveyard, so the static as it stands lets Hazezon play every land from the graveyard, a bigger card than printed; the vocabulary notes it 'cannot be narrowed by card type'. `cast_from_graveyard`'s `affects_spells` filter is the shape, but it is casting, not a land play. Desertwalk is the shipped `desertwalk` keyword, and 'Whenever a Desert you control enters' is an ordinary single-object `enters` trigger with a subtypes filter creating `sand_warrior_1_1_rgw` twice
